name: CCF Summer Programs
description_short: Summer learning camps by grade from Connecting for Children & Families, a Woonsocket non-profit: Camp Discovery (incoming K-2) and Chillin' & Skillin' (grades 3-5) mix theme-based math, literacy and science with arts, games and play; Get Connected (grades 6-8) is a 4-week career exploration camp.

sources.note: Grades K-5 page: Camp Discovery and Chillin' & Skillin', 2026 registration forms (Word files)
Grades 6-8 page: Get Connected 4-week Career Exploration Summer Camp; STEM, art, music; SeaPerch July 13 to 17 at Woonsocket High School
